description: Validates DR runbooks for RTO/RPO format validity, scenario completeness, failover configuration, communication plan, test schedule, and contract-level data-loss coverage

rules.description: dr-runbook-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare service, rto, rpo, and a non-empty scenarios array

rto and rpo must be valid ISO 8601 duration strings (e.g. PT4H, PT30M). rpo must not exceed rto — losing more data than the recovery window is operationally inconsistent. rto exceeding 24h requires skipRTOWarning: true
rules.format: ISO 8601 duration — PT prefix, fields: H (hours), M (minutes), S (seconds)

rules.description: Every scenario must declare name, trigger, steps (non-empty array), and owner. Every step must have an action field. Incomplete scenarios cannot be executed under pressure — missing fields make the runbook useless at the exact moment it is needed

When failover is declared, primaryRegion and secondaryRegion must both be specified and must be different regions. failover.strategy must be a recognised pattern. Gate skipped when spec.failover is absent

constraints.regions-different: primaryRegion and secondaryRegion must be different geographic regions

rules.description: The communication plan must declare incidentCommander, a non-empty escalationPath, and either statusPageUrl or statusChannel. An incident without a named commander is leaderless. Stakeholders without a status channel have no way to stay informed. Set skipCommunicationPlan: true for exemption

constraints.status-channel: statusPageUrl or statusChannel must be declared

rules.description: A testSchedule with frequency or cron must be declared. An untested runbook is a document, not a runbook. DR procedures degrade as systems change and must be regularly exercised. Set skipTestSchedule: true for exemption
dr-runbook-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers. A runbook with placeholders cannot be executed during a real disaster

Scenario names must be unique. At least one scenario must cover data loss, corruption, backup, or restore (set skipDataLossScenario: true for exemption). Every scenario must have an owner. When a k8s-workload-artifact is present, spec.service must match the compiled workload name

constraints.unique-scenario-names: each scenario name must be distinct
constraints.data-loss-scenario: at least one scenario must match /data.?loss|corrupt|backup|restore|recover/ unless skipDataLossScenario: true
constraints.scenario-owner: every scenario must have an owner field
constraints.service-workload-match: spec.service must match workload artifact when present — override with skipWorkloadMatch: true
